mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 6 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%) triggers Federal Reserve monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in unemployment rate signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE increased over the prior 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates real economy contraction, reducing corporate profits and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 2000 thousand units in a 3-month window signals housing sector slowdown, reducing construction activity and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST falls below 2000 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising) increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
